build_layout_head: build a LayoutHead module with angle and layout MLPs for 3D scene layout prediction
run_forward_layout_head: run the LayoutHead forward pass to predict angles and layouts from feature tensors
test_layout_head_loss: test the LayoutHead loss computation for angle and layout predictions against ground truth
get_bboxes_layout_head: get 3D bounding boxes and angles from LayoutHead predictions using get_bboxes method
review_layout_head_forward_single: review the LayoutHead _forward_single method that limits angles and exponentiates layout sizes
